Detailed Description

template<class OwnerType = void>
class MixFillEventBase< OwnerType >

An event class for use with a MixFill UGen.

You can use an OwnerType to reference another object when the UGen is constructed. Use MixFillEventBase<void> or MixFillEventBase<> if there's no owner.

See also:
MixFill , MixFillEventBase<void>
Template Parameters:
OwnerType Optional owner type (defaults to void).
